objective: Browse older library items using Older and Newer navigation.
deliverable: Reviewable pull request with passing tests; no merge or deployment.
requirements: Use deterministic ordering with an ID tie-breaker when creation timestamps match.
Preserve authenticated owner filtering on every page and existing access controls.
Bound page size and reject malformed pagination inputs.
Provide Older and Newer navigation, empty-state messaging and a distinct read-error state.
Preserve existing upload and draft-review behavior.

Export LIBRARY_PAGE_SIZE (10) and paginateLibraryItems(rows, ownerId, { cursor, direction }) from src/lib/library-pagination.ts: rows are { id, created_at, owner_id } in any order; return { items, olderCursor, newerCursor } newest first (created_at desc, then id desc), filtered to ownerId, with each cursor an opaque string that is non-null exactly when more rows exist in that direction; return null for malformed input, including a cursor without a direction or a direction without a cursor. The dashboard must obtain its items, olderCursor and newerCursor by calling paginateLibraryItems with the authenticated owner's rows (owner-filtered in the query); it must not reimplement cursor or range logic. Loading the owner's rows for this is acceptable for this library's size, and adds no schema migration or service.
pending_before_live_use: Reviewed file scope; recheck pinned target commit before live admission
Fresh bounded task authorization and allowance
acceptance_tests_note: Factory-owned tests run unchanged in the sandbox after the repository checks; the builder cannot edit them and must make them pass.
